description: Coast Conservation & Coastal Resources Management  Department -  Notify the Sri Lanka Coastal Zone and Coastal Resource Management Plan - 2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and implementation of the Sri Lanka Coastal Zone and Coastal Resource Management Plan - 2018 under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act. It establishes regulatory frameworks, management strategies, and legal compliance requirements for coastal resource management, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a minister's name appears in the notification signature, this is incidental to the main content which focuses on the regulatory plan itself rather than personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
